subject: CEII 2026 in Shenzhen | Submission Deadline: November 30, 2026 | Springer LNNS | EI & Scopus-2026-11-14 22:50:49
body:
You don't often get email from [name]@fpnwl.com. 
Learn why this is important 
 Dear Colleague ,
 I hope you are doing well.
 We would like to invite you to contribute a paper to the
 9th Asia Conference on Cognitive Engineering and Intelligent Interaction (CEII 2026) , which will be held at
 The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, from December 11–13, 2026 .
 The conference covers a broad range of topics, including
 Artificial Intelligence, Cognitive Science, Human-AI Teaming, Intelligent Interaction, Computational Biology, and Computer Vision .
 Keynote Speakers: 
 Prof. Cheng-Lin Liu, CAA Fellow, CAAI Fellow, IAPR Fellow, IEEE Fellow , Institute of Automation of Chinese Academy of Sciences
 Prof. Hongliang REN , The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong
 Prof. Ching Y. Suen, IEEE Fellow, IAPR Fellow, RSC Fellow , Concordia University
 Prof. David ZHANG, IEEE Life Fellow, IAPR Fellow, RSC Fellow, CAE Fellow, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
 Publication: 
Accepted and presented papers will be published in Springer LNNS and submitted for consideration by
 EI Compendex and Scopus .
 Submission Deadline: November 30, 2026
 Website: 
https://www.ceii.asia 
 Submission: 
 https://ceii.asia/openconf/openconf.php 
 Email: cfp@ceii.asia 
 CEII 2026 provides an opportunity to present recent research, exchange ideas with international researchers, and explore potential academic collaborations.
 We sincerely welcome your submission and participation.
 Best regards,
 [sender]
CEII 2026 Organizing Committee
 Unsubscribe: cfp@ceii.asia

Dear Doctor,
I want to take a minute of your busy life
Warm greetings from the International Journal of Clinical Studies and Medical Case Reports (IJCMCR)<https://shorturl.at/npsvN>. (ISSN: 2692-5877).
We are pleased to inform you that we are planning to release our Volume: 62 Issue: 3 in our journal. Research, Review, Case Report, Video Article, Short Communication, Mini Review, Image, Letter Editor, Opinion, Perspective, Book Review and Editorial Articles etc. are welcome for possible publications in this issue.
Kindly submit your article to our journal. For this issue we will give complete waive off. (DOI and Processing charges are applicable).
This offer available till November 25th, 2026, If you have any queries regarding the submission deadline inform to us.
Looking forward to hear a quick and positive response from yours end!!
Have a good day!!
With Regards,
[sender]
Editorial Manager

subject: Remind: [ASP- Innovative Medicines & Omics] – Invitation to Contribute to /[sender]/
body:
You don't often get email from [name]@accscience.org. Learn why this is important<https://aka.ms/LearnAboutSenderIdentification>
Dear Dr. [recipient],
A kind reminder in case you missed the letter below.
--------------------------------------------------------
Hope this email finds you well.
We have carefully read your article:
"[paper title]".
We would like to invite you to contribute to [sender] and *waive the full publication fees* until September 30, 2026.
[sender] is an international, double-blind peer-reviewed, quick-refereeing open-access journal.
Electronic ISSN: 3060-8740
Print ISSN: 3060-8910
Date of Foundation: 2024-09-26
Indexing: Google Scholar, J-Gate, ICMJE, Gale
Editors-in-Chief: Rui Miguel Pinheiro Vitorino, Changyuan Yu
The journal publishes articles related to pharmacy and omics in the field of animal and human health. The journal may focus on drug development, drug delivery, new drugs, etc. It includes a variety of omics layers, such as genomics, proteomics, epigenomics, metabolomics, lipidomics, peptidomics, metagenomics, microbiome, pharmacogenomics, toxicogenomics, etc., with the focus on disease etiology, prevention, treatment, prognosis and monitoring.
You can simply reply to this email.
-Yes, I will submit within the deadline.
-Yes, I plan to submit but I need more time, for example XX/XX/XX.
-No time/No interested.
We are looking forward to receiving your feedback at your earliest convenience.
Hope you have a great day!
Kind regards
[sender]

subject: AI-Driven Drug Repurposing | 16–18 Nov
body:
3-Day hands-on virtual workshop on AI, Network Pharmacology, Knowledge Graphs & Predictive Drug Discovery.
NanoSchool | Virtual Workshop
Advanced Research Training
AI-Driven Drug Repurposing: Network Pharmacology, Biomedical Knowledge Graphs & Predictive Discovery
Discover novel therapeutic candidates from existing drugs using Graph Neural Networks, knowledge graph embeddings, and transcriptomic signature reversal.
✔ Includes: Live Interactive Sessions | Session Recordings | Study Material & Code | Verifiable LinkedIn E-Certificate
Dates
16–18 November 2026
3 Days (Live Virtual)
 Time & Platform
7:30 PM IST
Live-Labs.org & Online
🛠️ Tools & Frameworks Covered: Open Targets, ChEMBL, STRING, Cytoscape, Reactome, GEO/GEO2R, limma, Enrichr/gseapy, L1000CDS2, SigCom LINCS, SwissADME, SwissDock, OpenFDA, SIDER, PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, and Repurpose Drug Discovery Lab.
Full Workshop Structure
📅 Day 1 – Network Pharmacology & Target Validation
* AI drug repurposing & disease gene identification (Open Targets).
* Drug–target mapping (ChEMBL) & PPI networks (STRING, Cytoscape).
* Pathway enrichment (Reactome) & therapeutic target prioritization.
🔬 Hands-On Lab: Drug–Target Network Construction & Pathway Enrichment
🧰 Tools: Open Targets | ChEMBL | STRING | Cytoscape | Reactome
📅 Day 2 – Transcriptomic Signatures & Signature Reversal
* Public omics sourcing (GEO) & DEG analysis (GEO2R, limma).
* DEG functional enrichment (Enrichr/gseapy) & network integration.
* Signature-based drug ranking via LINCS L1000 (L1000CDS2, SigCom LINCS).
🔬 Hands-On Lab: Disease Signature Extraction & Signature-Reversal Drug Ranking
🧰 Tools: GEO/GEO2R | limma | Enrichr/gseapy | L1000CDS2 | SigCom LINCS | Google Colab
📅 Day 3 – Candidate Prioritization & Evidence Validation
* Evidence-weighted candidate scoring & ADMET/BBB profiling (SwissADME).
* Molecular docking (SwissDock) & safety assessment (OpenFDA, SIDER).
* Clinical verification (PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov) & hypothesis development.
🔬 Hands-On Lab: Therapeutic Candidate Prioritization & Evidence Validation
🧰 Tools: Repurpose Drug Discovery Lab | Open Targets | ChEMBL | SwissADME | PubMed | ClinicalTrials.gov
Who Should Attend
PhD Scholars, Postdoctoral Researchers, Academic Faculty, Bioinformaticians, and Industry R&D Professionals seeking practical computational drug discovery skills.
Early enrollment recommended to secure your interactive live lab seat.

Dear Colleagues,
The International Conference on Advanced Sensors and IoT Communications (ASIC 2026)
December 4–6, 2026 | Sanya, China
The International Conference on Advanced Sensors and IoT Communications (ASIC 2026) will be held during December 4–6, 2026, in Sanya, China. The conference focuses on advanced sensor technologies and Internet of Things (IoT) communications, covering topics such as sensor design and fabrication, sensing and measurement technologies, wireless sensor networks, IoT communication systems, data acquisition and processing, as well as related applications.
Participation Methods
1. Full Paper submission
Submit full paper ( Regular Attendance Paper Publication Presentation )
- One author will be invited to make an oral presentation and the paper will be published.
- Publication: All the accepted papers will be published by a peer-reviewed open access journal that can ensure the widest dissemination of your published work.
- Index: CNKI and Google Scholar
- Full Paper Due: Oct. 19, 2026
- Reviewing period: 3-5 working days
2. Abstract submission
Submit abstract ( Regular Attendance Abstract Presentation )
- Abstract will be accepted and author will be invited to make an oral presentation.
3. Listeners
- Regular Attendance ( No Submission Required )
* If you are interested in it, please submit your paper/abstract by email directly.

Best regards,

subject: Agentic AI Engineering Planning, Tool Use & Multi-Agent :9 NOV,2026
body:
Build AI Agents that plan tasks, use tools, and collaborate using Python, LangChain, and LangGraph.
NSTC Virtual Hands-On Workshop
Agentic AI Engineering:
Planning, Tool Use & Multi-Agent Orchestration
Build AI Agents That Plan Tasks, Use Tools, and Collaborate to Solve Real-World Problems
Schedule
9–11 Nov 2026
5:30 PM IST
 Format
Mentor-Led
Live + Q&A
 Level & Duration
Virtual
60–90 Min/Day
About This Course
This 3-day hands-on workshop introduces the design and implementation of agentic AI systems using Python, LangChain, and LangGraph. Participants progressively build a tool-enabled agent, add context management and retrieval, and develop a multi-agent workflow with structured outputs, error handling, and performance evaluation.
Workshop Structure Matrix
Timeline Modules & Hands-On Focus
DAY 1 Agent Foundations Task Planning & Tool Use
• Execution loops, task decomposition & structured inputs/outputs.
• Connect agents to document search tools, calculators & error limits.
Hands-On: Build a tool-using agent for document search & calculations.
Tools: Python | LangChain | Pydantic | LLM API
DAY 2 Reliable Workflows Context, Retrieval & LangGraph
• Manage task history, conditional workflows & checkpoints in LangGraph.
• Implement retries, failure recovery & human-in-the-loop review.
Hands-On: Build a document research workflow with state retention.
Tools: LangGraph | Local RAG | Checkpointing
DAY 3 Multi-Agent Teams Orchestration & Capstone
• Supervisor-led workflows: researcher, analyst & reviewer roles.
• Evaluate task completion, latency, token usage & execution traces.
Hands-On Capstone: Build an AI research team to analyze datasets & draft reports.
Tools: LangGraph | Pandas | Pydantic | Tracing
What You'll Get:
✔ Live Interactive Sessions + Q&A with Industry Mentors
✔ Recorded Lectures & Study Materials in your Dashboard

Dear Professor,
We invite you to submit your original research to ICAMCDS - 2026, bringing together researchers, academics, scholars, and industry professionals to share recent developments and innovative work in Applied Mathematics, Computing, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science.
Why Submit?
* Present your research to an academic and professional audience
* Receive feedback and engage with researchers working in related areas
* Explore opportunities for collaboration and knowledge exchange
* Contribute to discussions around emerging research and applications

Conference: International Conference on Applied Mathematics, Computing and Data Science
Paper Submission Deadline: 15th October 2026

The EECSI2026 will be conducted soon. Herewith some details about the conference program:

Program: https://eecsi.org/elements/schedule/<https://eur05.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Feecsi.org%2Felements%2Fschedule%2F&data=05%7C02%[email]%7C81557150e5654999a3dd08df077eaf2d%7C849f9d2e596948b2a2ba2a9e31b13f97%7C0%7C0%7C639237912827471331%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Jen6aJCda7Q6FurSgaBkJMNw5UeEBYkYyql9wv%2BGmJA%3D&reserved=0>

You don't often get email from [name]@zionstaredtech.com. Learn why this is important<https://aka.ms/LearnAboutSenderIdentification>
Hi [recipient], I hope this message finds you well.
As an Associate Professor at Philadelphia University, you're likely navigating the evolving landscape of educational technology and its integration into your curriculum and administrative processes.
Many educators face challenges in effectively implementing AI and software solutions to enhance learning outcomes and streamline operations. The need for tailored strategies that fit the unique demands of your institution is critical in this fast-paced environment.
I'd like to invite you to a complimentary AI & Software Implementation Consultation, where we can explore how AI can support your goals in education and training.
During our session, we will examine current challenges you may be facing with technology integration, discuss best practices for maximizing the impact of AI in your programs, and identify specific software solutions that align with your institutional objectives.
I would love to find a time to connect and discuss these ideas further.

subject: Exploring a Potential Fit for Your Medical Research: Prof. [recipient]: Mega Journal of Medicine
body:
You don't often get email from editorial@medicalcaserep.info. Learn why this is important<https://aka.ms/LearnAboutSenderIdentification>
Dear Dr. [recipient],
I hope this message finds you well.
On behalf of the Editorial Office of Mega Journal of Medicine, I would like to invite you to consider the journal for your forthcoming research or scholarly contributions.
We welcome manuscripts that advance medical knowledge, strengthen clinical understanding, support evidence-based practice, and contribute to the ongoing development of healthcare. Subject to the journal’s scope and author guidelines, potential contributions may include original research articles, clinical studies, review articles, case reports, and other relevant scholarly work.
Our editorial interest lies in manuscripts that demonstrate scientific rigor, present clearly articulated findings, and offer meaningful insights for the medical and healthcare community. All submissions are evaluated in accordance with the journal’s editorial policies and applicable peer-review procedures.
If you are preparing a manuscript that aligns with the journal’s scope, we would welcome the opportunity to consider it for editorial assessment.
For further information about the journal and its submission requirements, please visit:
Manuscript submission: [Online Submission Form<https://eur05.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdenmark-publishers.globaljclincase.info%2Findex.php%2Fcampaigns%2Fdt675z14wr511%2Ftrack-url%2Flk196wnq316b6%2F1086e3b7991d4e443e5778a94c89fbdac6b7a02a&data=05%7C02%[email]%7C38a27d9f5d4041f6f26008df39d17462%7C849f9d2e596948b2a2ba2a9e31b13f97%7C0%7C0%7C639293381178641525%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C40000%7C%7C%7C&sdata=B1j0jRoiXPg4V8Su2iFC1xcvCfXOHHO0sWNC0a55MxA%3D&reserved=0>]
Thank you for your time and consideration. We appreciate the opportunity to introduce our journal and would be pleased to consider your future scholarly contributions.
Kind regards,

body:
You don't often get email from editorial@medicalcaserep.info. Learn why this is important<https://aka.ms/LearnAboutSenderIdentification>
Dear Dr. [recipient],
I hope this message finds you well.
On behalf of the Editorial Office of Mega Journal of Medicine, I would like to invite you to consider the journal for your forthcoming research or scholarly contributions.
We welcome manuscripts that advance medical knowledge, strengthen clinical understanding, support evidence-based practice, and contribute to the ongoing development of healthcare. Subject to the journal’s scope and author guidelines, potential contributions may include original research articles, clinical studies, review articles, case reports, and other relevant scholarly work.
Our editorial interest lies in manuscripts that demonstrate scientific rigor, present clearly articulated findings, and offer meaningful insights for the medical and healthcare community. All submissions are evaluated in accordance with the journal’s editorial policies and applicable peer-review procedures.
If you are preparing a manuscript that aligns with the journal’s scope, we would welcome the opportunity to consider it for editorial assessment.
For further information about the journal and its submission requirements, please visit:

subject: Hands-On AI & Machine Learning Applications in Materials Science
body:
You don't often get email from info@noti.dstc.org.in. Learn why this is important<https://aka.ms/LearnAboutSenderIdentification>
Explore practical machine learning workflows for materials property prediction and energy materials discovery.
DSTC
DEEP SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CONSORTIUM
AI & Machine Learning for Materials Science and Energy Materials
Data-Driven Discovery, Property Prediction & Optimization for Battery, Photovoltaic and Functional Materials.
Bringing Machine Learning into Materials Research
This three-day practical workshop introduces data-driven workflows for materials research, covering materials database extraction, feature engineering, supervised learning, property prediction and virtual screening of energy materials.
Participants will explore research datasets and predictive models through guided practical exercises using Google Colab.
Workshop Curriculum
DAY 01 | AI/ML Foundations for Materials Science
Materials informatics, research databases and materials data preprocessing.
Practical Lab: Extract crystallographic data and generate ML-ready descriptors using Matminer.
DAY 02 | Machine Learning for Property Prediction
Supervised learning, Random Forest, XGBoost and model evaluation.
Practical Lab: Predict band gap and formation energy with model tuning and SHAP analysis.
DAY 03 | AI/ML for Energy Materials Discovery
Energy materials applications, virtual screening and Graph Neural Networks.
Practical Lab: Screen and rank candidate battery electrolytes and perovskite solar absorbers.
Research Tools & Technologies
Materials Project | NOMAD | AFLOW
Matminer | Pymatgen | Python
Random Forest | XGBoost | SHAP
Google Colab | Graph Neural Networks
Workshop Schedule
WORKSHOP DATES
17–19 November 2026 LIVE SESSION
7:00 PM IST
FORMAT
Live Interactive PLATFORM
Microsoft Teams + Google Colab
Academic Learning Resources

Dear Dr. [recipient],
I hope you are doing well.
I am writing to follow up on our previous correspondence regarding your
potential submission to Molecules and the possibility of APC support.
May I kindly ask whether you currently have a manuscript under
preparation? If so, could you please share the preliminary manuscript
information requested in my previous email, including the tentative
title, a brief abstract, the author list and affiliations, and your
estimated submission date?
Once I receive these details, I will be happy to forward them to the
Editorial Office for further evaluation of possible APC support.
Please feel free to let me know if you have any questions. I look
forward to hearing from you. Hope you have a nice day!
Best wishes,

I hope you are doing well.
I wanted to briefly follow up on my previous message regarding academic research and publication support. I would be glad to know if you currently have any ongoing manuscript, research project, or upcoming publication requirement where our team could assist.
We provide support across various stages, including manuscript preparation and improvement, academic editing, journal selection, formatting, submission assistance, and reviewer response support.
If you have any current or upcoming research work, kindly share the topic and present status. I would be pleased to understand your requirements and discuss the appropriate support options.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Kind regards

Research & Reviews: Journal of Agricultural Science and Technology invites original agricultural science and technology research manuscripts.
STM JOURNALS · CALL FOR PAPERS
Research & Reviews: Journal of Agricultural Science and Technology
E-ISSN: 2278-2206 · P-ISSN: 2349-3682
Dear Agricultural Scientist,
Research & Reviews: Journal of Agricultural Science and Technology (RRJOAST) invites original research articles, reviews, and case studies on all aspects of agricultural science, technology innovation, crop production, sustainable farming, farm economics, and agricultural extension.
JOURNAL AT A GLANCE
Publishing Since 2012
Frequency 3 Issues/Year
Language English
DOI 10.37591/RRJOAST
WHY PUBLISH WITH RRJOAST?
Peer Review: Expert agricultural scientists and technologists ensure rigorous quality assessment.
Research Visibility: Indexed in Index Copernicus, SCILIT, and Google Scholar for maximum discoverability.
High Impact Metrics: SJIF 6.038 and ICV 61.92 demonstrates consistent recognition in agricultural research.
Hybrid Open Access: Multiple publication options to maximize research reach and impact in agricultural communities.
Proven Track Record: Publishing since 2012 with 69 articles in 2024 and average acceptance time of 15-20 days.
TOPICS IN SCOPE
• Crop Production & Management: Crop cultivation, soil management, irrigation, pest management, yield optimization
• Plant Breeding & Genetics: Crop improvement, genetic traits, hybrid development, disease resistance
• Agricultural Technology & Innovation: Precision agriculture, farm mechanization, agricultural machinery, IoT in farming
• Sustainable & Organic Farming: Sustainable practices, organic agriculture, conservation farming, agroecology
• Soil Science & Fertility: Soil health, fertility management, nutrient cycling, soil conservation
• Horticulture & Vegetable Science: Fruit production, vegetable cultivation, post-harvest management, quality improvement
• Animal Husbandry & Livestock: Dairy farming, poultry, livestock management, fodder production
• Agricultural Economics & Farm Management: Farm economics, cost-benefit analysis, market linkages, farmer income
• Aquaculture & Fisheries: Fish farming, fisheries management, aquaculture economics
• Agricultural Extension & Rural Development: Extension services, farmer awareness, rural livelihoods, community development
• Water Resources & Irrigation: Irrigation systems, water management, watershed management, rainwater harvesting
• Climate Change & Agriculture: Climate-smart agriculture, climate adaptation, resilience, weather forecasting
BENEFITS OF PUBLISHING
✓ Agricultural Science Leadership: Premier journal advancing agricultural science and technology globally.
✓ Expert Editorial Direction: Led by Prof. Sankar Kumar Acharya, BCKV West Bengal, a recognized agricultural extension expert.
✓ Rapid Publication: Average acceptance time 15-20 days and publication time 30 days ensures timely dissemination.
✓ Comprehensive Coverage: Crop science, technology innovation, farm economics, sustainability, and rural development.
✓ Easy Submission & Tracking: Online manuscript engine with transparent peer review and real-time status tracking.

subject: Special Issue on "Statistical Thought and Methodology" - Manuscript Due: October 28th, 2026
body:
You don't often get email from ojs@intakw.com. Learn why this is important<https://aka.ms/LearnAboutSenderIdentification>
Call for publication of Special Issue on "Statistical Thought and Methodology"
Citations>7349; Articles>882; Downloads > 2,399,798; Views>5,024,756; Citations/article>3.0; Downloads/article>1952.9
CALL FOR PAPERS
Special Issue: "Statistical Thought and Methodology" (Submission Deadline: October 28th, 2026)
Journal: Open Journal of Statistics (OJS, ISSN Online: "2161-7198") (For a thorough examination into our journal, including author's guidelines and all open special issues, please explore the authorized website by searching the name of the journal and ISSN online.)
Dear [recipient],
I sincerely hope this email finds you in good health.
We are delighted to contact you with some captivating updates about the forthcoming themed issue called "Statistical Thought and Methodology" in the highly esteemed international journal "Open Journal of Statistics" (OJS). It brings us great joy to invite you warmly to contribute your precious research works in this esteemed edition, taking into account your proficiency and deep knowledge in this field. By participating to this special issue, you will not only enhance the reputation of our esteemed journal but also make a substantial contribution to the progress of knowledge in this area.
Swift Review & Publication: Anticipate feedback within 7-14 days of submission and expect publication within 2 to 3 days after confirming the typeset proof.
Visibility & Impact: Leverage our expansive reach, with massive downloads, ensuring your work attains considerable visibility and potential citations.
For submissions, please forward your paper to: paper@openaccessj.com
If you are interested in being the Guest Editor for this Topic, please do not hesitate to respond to this email at paper@openaccessj.com to discuss further details.
When sending across your work, we respectfully request you to specify "OJS Special Issue Statistical Thought and Methodology" in the subject line to ensure its timely and accurate review.
If you're interested, we would be thrilled to get any queries from you and to be notified of your submission plan.
And we're also warmly welcome submissions to our ordinary issue.
We Invite Submissions In (but not exclusively limited to)
* Philosophical Foundations of Statistics
* Core Classical Statistical Thoughts
* Causal Inference
* Simulation and Resampling Inference
* Modern Statistical Modeling Theories
* Robust and Adaptive Statistical Analysis
* Exploratory Data Analysis
* General Statistical Computation Frameworks
Explore digital published articles in OJS
Strong Consistency of the Spline-Estimation of Probabilities Density in Uniform Metric
Kiyotaka Iki
10.4236/ojs.2016.63044
Analysis of Variance in an Unbalanced Two-Way Mixed Effect Interactive Model
Heni Boubaker, Nadia Sghaier
10.4236/ojs.2016.64047
Decomposition of Generalized Asymmetry Model for Square Contingency Tables
Lakhkar Khan, Javid Shabbir
10.4236/ojs.2016.63043
We enthusiastically await receiving your written work or any questions you might have.
Kind regards,
Prof. Zudi Lu (City University of Hong Kong，China)
Editor-in-Chief
OJS Editorial Office
[email]
If you prefer not to receive future emails from us, please reply to this message with your request. Additionally, if you have alternative email addresses that may be on our list, please share them so we can ensure they're also excluded.

subject: Spotlight: Our valued peer reviewers
body:
You don't often get email from newsletters-updates@cellpress-cp.email.elsevier.com. Learn why this is important<https://aka.ms/LearnAboutSenderIdentification>
Spotlight: Our valued peer reviewers
 <https://clients.thedesignforge.co.uk/cellpress/innovation/innovation_header.jpg>
 <https://clients.thedesignforge.co.uk/cellpress/innovation/2026/CP2604181/CP2604181_XINN_Spotlight_Peer_Reviewers_hero01.jpg>
Peer review is the cornerstone of scholarly integrity, ensuring that advances and discoveries are rigorously evaluated before dissemination. Every published breakthrough relies on the dedication of expert reviewers who give their critical judgment to uphold the highest standards of scientific quality. We are delighted to share the perspectives of three of our reviewers, whose invaluable contributions are so vital to upholding The Innovation's mission to publish high-impact research at the interface of cutting-edge science and global health challenges.
Learn more
 <https://clients.thedesignforge.co.uk/cellpress/innovation/2026/CP2604181/CP2604181_XINN_Spotlight_Peer_Reviewers_editor01.png> Yue Chang, Associate Research Professor
Institute of Spatiotemporal Geographical Information Intelligence, Moganshan Geospatial Information Laboratory, Hangzhou, China
“In the age of AI, generating information is easier than ever, but ensuring rigor, clarity, and trust in science matters even more. Thoughtful peer review helps transform fast-moving ideas into reliable knowledge, while fostering a rigorous, credible, and collaborative research community.”
Expertise
My research focuses on geospatial artificial intelligence, remote sensing, and urban heat hazards, with particular interests in geospatial foundation models, intelligent interpretation of remote sensing imagery, and AI applications for climate change and urban sustainability.
 <https://clients.thedesignforge.co.uk/cellpress/innovation/2026/CP2604181/CP2604181_XINN_Spotlight_Peer_Reviewers_editor02.png> Assoc. Prof., Dr. [sender]
Soil Resource and Information Division,
Institute of Soil Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences, China
“Serving as a peer reviewer for The Innovation is both a privilege and a responsibility. In an era defined by complex global changes, it is imperative that we uphold the highest standards of scientific rigor. I am proud to support the journal's mission to spotlight transformative research–from digital soil mapping to deep-soil biogeochemistry–that advances our understanding of Earth's critical zone and fosters sustainable soil health.”
Expertise
My research integrates digital soil mapping with biogeochemical process characterization to elucidate key dynamics in deep soils and their eco-environmental implications. I focus on quantifying the transport and legacy of nitrogen in deep vadose zones and groundwater, leveraging data-driven approaches to assess soil health and carbon-nitrogen-water feedbacks under global environmental change.
 <https://clients.thedesignforge.co.uk/cellpress/innovation/2026/CP2604181/CP2604181_XINN_Spotlight_Peer_Reviewers_editor03.png> Dr. [sender], Distinguished Associate Research Fellow
Zhejiang University Executive Director, International Digital Empowerment & Artificial intelligence Lab for Health (IDEA Lab)
Executive Editor-in-Chief, Health Psychology Research
“Peer review is more than a scholarly critique; it is a collaborative safeguard ensuring that scientific innovations are both groundbreaking and ethically sound. Contributing to The Innovation allows me to support a platform that champions interdisciplinary solutions, particularly at the nexus of artificial intelligence and public health, to reshape global health landscapes.”
Expertise
I lead research at the intersection of Population Health Behaviors and Digital Health (AI in Health). My team utilizes large-scale national surveys (such as the PBICR project) and AI-driven interventions (like the AI-HEALS system) to address chronic disease management and public mental health. I am particularly interested in how digital tools can bridge gaps in health equity, a theme highly relevant to the scope of The Innovation.
 <https://clients.thedesignforge.co.uk/cellpress/innovation/2026/CP2604181/CP2604181_XINN_Spotlight_Peer_Reviewers_cover01a.jpg> The Innovation aims to promote scientific discovery and application by publishing across all scientific disciplines including physics, chemistry, materials, nanotechnology, biology, translational medicine, geoscience, and engineering. We are dedicated to publishing significant advances promptly with transparent processes and the efficient promotion of translations from scientific discovery to technological achievements.

subject: Still booking live sessions by hand?
body:
You don't often get email from [name]@aimentor.co.in. Learn why this is important<https://aka.ms/LearnAboutSenderIdentification>
Hi [recipient],
Quick question: does your team still arrange live sessions by hand, checking who is free, pasting the Zoom or Teams link and sending the reminders yourselves?
We're building Sessionly, a booking layer for live teaching. Students book the service they need, the right instructor is assigned by skill and availability, the meeting link is created automatically, and every session becomes a record you can report on.

subject: To Dr. [recipient] - Call for Papers: [IJoSI (Scopus)] Submit by December 15 and Enjoy a 30% Discount
body:
You don't often get email from [name]@accscience.org. Learn why this is important<https://aka.ms/LearnAboutSenderIdentification>
Dear Dr. [recipient],
I hope this email finds you well.
This is [sender] from the International Journal of Systematic Innovation (IJoSI) (ISSN 2077-8767), a peer-reviewed and open access journal indexed by Scopus (CiteScore 1.2 for 2025) and EBSCO.
Given your accomplishments in this field, we believe your expertise would greatly benefit our readers, and we would be honored to invite you to submit your research work to our journal.
To support researchers and encourage high-quality submissions, we are pleased to offer a limited-time discount: 30% off the Article Processing Charge (APC) for all manuscripts submitted by December 15, 2026.
Our journal focuses on the algorithmic aspects of artificial intelligence and systematic innovation methodologies, including TRIZ, design thinking, technological innovation, and other approaches that drive creative problem-solving and advancements across industries. Submissions must present original research that has not been previously peer-reviewed or published in IJoSI or any other journal.
By publishing with us, you will:
* Share your research with a global audience of innovation scholars and practitioners.
* Benefit from a rigorous peer-review process.
* Enhance your academic profile in a journal committed to fostering interdisciplinary innovation research.
We would greatly value the opportunity to partner with you and to further the reach of your research.
To let us know your thoughts on this invitation, please kindly reply to this email with a simple answer Yes or No.
* Yes – I plan to contribute a paper in the near future.
* Yes, but – I am interested but need more time.
* No, but – I do not have papers/time but will share the news with my colleagues.
* No – I am not interested.
You may also submit your manuscript directly via the IJoSI submission system: https://accscience.com/user/manuscripts/submission?journal_name=IJOSI<https://eur05.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Faccscience.com%2Fuser%2Fmanuscripts%2Fsubmission%3Fjournal_name%3DIJOSI&data=05%7C02%[email]%7Ced9ad7d0fe5f483f613308df3b3cef49%7C849f9d2e596948b2a2ba2a9e31b13f97%7C0%7C0%7C639294805190874428%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C40000%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Wd3RnT17033fUQMOKt5QZymzShopZbG6jG1MD63XZk8%3D&reserved=0>

subject: Would You Consider Joining Us as a Speaker?
body:
You don't often get email from [name]@inscitechseries.com. Learn why this is important<https://aka.ms/LearnAboutSenderIdentification>
Dear [recipient],
We are pleased to invite you to contribute as a Speaker at the 3rd Edition of InSciTech Meet on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (IMAIMLSUMMIT2027), taking place March 29–31, 2027, in Toronto, Canada.
Your research on “Classifying Of Pension Companies Operating In Turkey” aligns well with the scientific themes of the meeting, and we believe your perspective would contribute meaningfully to discussions on the latest developments and applications of AI and machine learning.

subject: Discover Artificial Intelligence: Decision on your manuscript
body:
[غالبا ما لا تحصل على بريد إلكتروني من discoverai@springernature.com. تعرف على سبب أهمية ذلك على https://aka.ms/LearnAboutSenderIdentification ]
Ref: Submission ID [manuscript ID]
Decision: minor revision
Deadline: 15 Jul 2026
Dear Dr [recipient],
Thank you for submitting your manuscript, "[paper title]", to our journal Discover Artificial Intelligence . Our Quality Check of your submission has now taken place. As a result, we need you to address the following point before your manuscript can progress any further:
1. Revise title
To aid our readers, and to maximize the accessibility of your manuscript, the title should have a clear, precise scientific meaning. Where possible, the title should be read as one concise sentence, without the use of punctuation (full stops, colons, hyphens, question marks etc.). Please could you re-write the title ensuring that it is informative and appropriate? Also update the modified title in the manuscript, submission system and cover letter.
2. Ethical Statement:
The manuscript describes experiments using healthcare and IoMT workloads (ECG, heart-rate, blood pressure, etc.) but does not state whether those workloads derive from real patient data, controlled-access clinical records, or solely from simulated/public datasets. The authors explicitly say workloads were "generated" and that evaluation used a "simulated" distributed environment, yet they do not clarify the source or nature (de-identified public, synthetic, or private clinical) of the data. Under the decision rules, ambiguity about whether human data or protected clinical records were used necessitates a human ethics statement. Therefore a human ethics statement is REQUIRED (the manuscript should state whether human subjects/data were involved and, if so, provide ethics approval and consent details; if only synthetic/public de-identified data were used, this should be explicitly stated).
As per our journal policy, it is mandatory to provide the full name of the ethical committee and the ethical guidelines followed in the study, particularly if humans were involved. We therefore request you to all the three statements in the manuscript under declaration section
i. We request all original research involving human research participants or live vertebrates includes an ethics statement. The name of the ethics committee/IRB that approved the study or waived the need for approval must be provided.
ii. The statement should also note in accordance-that the research was carried out following the guidelines of the ethics committee listed in the ethics statement.
For example, the protocol was approved by [named committee/IRB] in accordance with the [named relevant guidelines and regulations]. Please find our policy via the link below: https://eur05.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.springer.com%2Fjournal%2F44163%2Fsubmission-guidelines%23Instructions%2520for%2520Authors_Research%2520involving%2520human%2520participants%2C%2520their%2520data%2520or%2520biological%2520material&data=05%7C02%[email]%7C7ef5fcbf63f040e7f6ed08dee0a5b29a%7C849f9d2e596948b2a2ba2a9e31b13f97%7C0%7C0%7C639195199442989367%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=1hoXsu%2BYAdFdZte8ew1wMu%2BIj4QoKWT28ENW%2FSIxcxc%3D&reserved=0
C. Consent to participate: We request author to include, "informed consent" to participate in the study must be obtained from participants (or their parent or legal guardian in the case of children under 16). Please could you provide a statement to this effect in the manuscript.
Please find our policy and statement examples via the link below: https://eur05.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.springer.com%2Fjournal%2F44163%2Fsubmission-guidelines%23Instructions%2520for%2520Authors_Informed%2520&data=05%7C02%[email]%7C7ef5fcbf63f040e7f6ed08dee0a5b29a%7C849f9d2e596948b2a2ba2a9e31b13f97%7C0%7C0%7C639195199443023211%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=HVpnWj0NN2IECTFuC9VfSauwD3pWgqyXBfQw0uKfSJo%3D&reserved=0 consent
3. Data Availability statement:
We noticed that you have provided a Data Availability Statement in the manuscript as "The data supporting the findings of this study are
available within the article.". Kindly ensure that the same statement is included in the submission system. It should not be "No" in the data availability declaration.
Requesting you to please make all the above listed changes in the manuscript and kindly submit this revised manuscript within the next 48h, using the following link: https://eur05.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fsubmission.springernature.com%2Fsubmission-details%2F2e69cfce-a507-4d70-92b8-721c1f558a50&data=05%7C02%[email]%7C7ef5fcbf63f040e7f6ed08dee0a5b29a%7C849f9d2e596948b2a2ba2a9e31b13f97%7C0%7C0%7C639195199443048987%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=b8wvZDRNeso4AN%2Fcy6r11%2BANgBo9VzicPpypZoeqB3c%3D&reserved=0
Please note: You are required to make all revisions directly in the original manuscript file and upload this updated file to the system.
If you have any further questions, please feel free to contact us.
Kind regards,

Dear Professor [recipient],
First of all, congratulations on the initial publication of your
article. We are pleased to see that your manuscript has progressed to
the proof stage.
After reviewing the proof version, I noticed that there are still a
number of details that require careful attention and revision. Please
review all the comments provided in the proof carefully and make the
necessary corrections in detail. A thorough revision at this stage will
help avoid multiple rounds of further revision after resubmission due to
formatting or production requirements.
To assist you, I have summarized several of the more prominent issues below:
1.Figures: In many figures, the first word of the title or heading
appears to be truncated, with only part of the word displayed. Please
carefully check and adjust the figures to ensure that all text is fully
visible.
2.References: Please ensure that references are cited in the correct
sequential order according to their first appearance in the main text.
Please adjust the reference order where necessary.
3.Tables and figures: Please review the order of the tables and ensure
that they are cited sequentially according to their first appearance in
the text. In general, tables should appear after their first mention in
the manuscript. If you believe that any table should remain in its
current position for a particular reason, please leave us a comment, and
we can submit a relevant request accordingly. However, we recommend
making appropriate adjustments wherever possible.
4.Table Shading: Some tables contain colored or shaded backgrounds.
Please confirm whether these background colors are necessary and should
be retained.
5.Supplementary Material: You mentioned supplementary material both in
the main text and in the Data Availability Statement (DAS). However,
there is currently no corresponding reference to a supplementary file in
the back matter. I have added the relevant wording according to the
template. Please provide the corresponding supplementary file and revise
the relevant sections accordingly.
In addition to the issues listed above, there are several other points
that require your attention. Please carefully review and address all
comments provided in the proof version.
As there are quite a number of issues requiring revision in the current
proof, we kindly ask you to make the revisions as thoroughly and
carefully as possible. This will help us avoid repeated rounds of
corrections and ensure that the revised proof meets the relevant
requirements.
If you have any questions during the revision process, please feel free
to contact me at any time. Once you have completed all revisions, please
submit the revised version through the provided link.
Thank you for your careful cooperation and attention to these revisions.
Kind regards,

Dear [recipient] [recipient],
We wrote you a letter on the date below, but you didn't get back to us. We are writing to you for the second time, and we hope that this time you will think about what we asked.
We can find out what's wrong and try to fix it if you reply to our message.
Please write a letter of application and send it to this address. Please let us know within a day if you agree.
OJS Trusted Online Submission Link: https://dx.doi.org/10.29328/submit-article
I hope you can help us with the problem that is coming up.
Please respond to stop the follow-ups.
Good luck,
Franklin Mavis, Journal Operations Manager
International Journal of Physics Research and Applications (ISSN 2766-2748)
______________________________________________Monday, July 21, 2026, at 11:30:15 AM To: [email]<mailto:[email]> Subject: [email]<mailto:[email]> | IJPRA
Dear [recipient] [recipient],
This journal invited you earlier but we got no response from your end, so it is taking liberty to reach you again with this request. Can you give a minute to discuss?
On behalf of board members, we cordially invite you to submit a paper (like your previous publication: [paper title] you are the right person to fulfil our issue.
We assure you that the journal fulfils the author's primary requirements for publication successfully with clear transparency and quality processes.
If you have a paper in your hand or are in the process of writing a paper or planning to write a paper, consider this invitation a top priority.
If your answer is yes, please share the acceptance within 24-48 hours; if it is no, we can understand your busy schedule, and we feel regret not to have a chance to serve you.
Approaching Deadline: September 29, 2026 for the September issue.
Remote Deadline: October 06, 2026 for the September issue.
We respectfully ask that you confirm by responding with one of the following choices so that we can effectively resolve the matter:
YES - I'm interested. Kindly share the manuscript directly to this email as an attachment along with cover letter or provide the tentative submission date.
NO - Kindly share the reason so we may update our records accordingly.
The rolling submissions are accepted and the deadline can be extended on author request, as we are looking for quality submissions and definitely it will take more time.
I hope you will be there to assist us and you'll never disappoint us without replying to us.
The reply is requested to avoid follow-ups.
Regards,
Franklin Mavis, USA
International Journal of Physics Research and Applications (ISSN 2766-2748)
|EID1084-IJPRA|

PLEASE DISSEMINATE THE CALL FOR PAPERS
CALL FOR PAPERS - DON'T MISS OUT
SUBMISSION OPEN
A HYBRID (VIRTUAL & PHYSICAL) CONFERENCE
IEEE-International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Systems, and Emerging Technologies (Hybrid) April 21-23, 2026, AlShorouk Academy, EGYPT
The International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Systems, and Emerging Technologies - IEEE/ICAISET'26 is an annual event dedicated to exploring cutting-edge technologies in digital information, artificial intelligence, data science, biomedical applications, and cybersecurity. It will be held at AlShorouk Academy, Higher Institute of Compute and Information Technology<https://siro.sha.edu.eg/hicit.php> It provides a platform for researchers and practitioners to engage in meaningful discussions about the latest trends in these areas and fosters opportunities for collaborative research both locally and internationally. This three-day conference will feature oral and poster presentations, alongside plenary sessions led by distinguished speakers. All submitted papers will undergo a rigorous peer-review process by two reviewers using the single-blind methodology. Accepted papers will be compiled into an electronic proceedings volume and submitted for indexing. IEEE/ICAISET'26 presents a unique opportunity for participants to network with leading researchers engaged in cutting-edge projects. It also offers an excellent platform to showcase your university or institution to prominent academic leaders and renowned scholars, opening doors to potential collaborations and visibility in the global research community.
https://edas.info/newPaper.php?c=34262&track=133255
https://icca-conf.info/icaiset25
Thank you
[sender]

IEEE-International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Systems, and Emerging Technologies (Hybrid) April 21-23 2026, AlShorouk Academy, EGYPT
The International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Systems, and Emerging Technologies – IEEE/ICAISET'26 is an annual event dedicated to exploring cutting-edge technologies in digital information, artificial intelligence, data science, biomedical applications, and cybersecurity. It will be held at AlShorouk Academy, Higher Institute of Compute and Information Technology<https://siro.sha.edu.eg/hicit.php> It provides a platform for researchers and practitioners to engage in meaningful discussions about the latest trends in these areas and fosters opportunities for collaborative research both locally and internationally. This three-day conference will feature oral and poster presentations, alongside plenary sessions led by distinguished speakers. All submitted papers will undergo a rigorous peer-review process by two reviewers using the single-blind methodology. Accepted papers will be compiled into an electronic proceedings volume and submitted for indexing. IEEE/ICAISET'26 presents a unique opportunity for participants to network with leading researchers engaged in cutting-edge projects. It also offers an excellent platform to showcase your university or institution to prominent academic leaders and renowned scholars, opening doors to potential collaborations and visibility in the global research community.

https://icca-conf.info/icaiset25
Thank you
[sender]

subject: Invitation to Participate in the International Conference on AI Challenges in Business and Management (ICAICBM 2027)
body:
Invitation to Participate in the International Conference on AI Challenges in Business and Management (ICAICBM 2027) 
لا تتلقى غالباً بريداً إلكترونياً من [name]@glarepublishing.com. 
تعرّف على سبب أهمية هذا 
 Dear Distinguished Scholar,
 I hope this message finds you well.
 On behalf of the Organising Committee, it is our great pleasure to invite you to submit your research to the First International Conference on AI Challenges in Business and Management ( ICAICBM 2027 ), taking place on 23–24 March 2027, fully
 online via Microsoft Teams.
 ICAICBM 2027 is a peer-reviewed international academic conference dedicated to advancing interdisciplinary inquiry at the intersection of artificial intelligence, business strategy, management practice, organisational behaviour, finance,
 ethics, governance, and related disciplines. The conference aims to bring together distinguished scholars, researchers, and practitioners from across the globe to exchange knowledge, foster meaningful collaborations, and produce impactful research that addresses
 the most pressing challenges posed by AI in contemporary business and society.
 The conference is actively seeking Scopus indexing, reflecting our commitment to the highest standards of academic excellence and research integrity.
 We would be honoured to receive your contribution and warmly invite you to submit a paper for presentation and publication through the GLARE website at https://glarepublishing.com/singleconference/international-conference-on-ai-challenges-in-business-and-management-icaicbm-2027.
 Your participation would greatly enrich the academic quality of the conference and provide an excellent opportunity to present your research to an international audience.
 Beyond paper submission, authors wishing to take a more active role are welcome to express their interest in serving as an
 Editor (Reviewer) for ICAICBM 2027 . Those with relevant academic expertise may also be considered for future editorial roles with the AI Challenges in Business and Management journal. Should you wish to serve in this capacity,
 please send an expression of interest to [name]@glarepublishing.com and we will be pleased to provide full details regarding editorial responsibilities and explore potential avenues for collaboration.
 By participating in ICAICBM 2027 , you will have the opportunity to:
 Present your research to a distinguished international academic audience Collaborate with leading scholars and researchers from around the world Enhance your academic visibility and expand your global professional network Contribute to advancing knowledge on the challenges and opportunities of AI in business and management Join a growing international academic initiative committed to research excellence and scholarly impact 
 Thank you for considering this invitation. We very much look forward to receiving your contribution to
 ICAICBM 2027 and to the prospect of a meaningful and lasting collaboration.
 For any enquiries regarding paper submission, the conference programme, or Reviewer opportunities, please do not hesitate to reach out by replying directly to this email or contacting us at [name]@glarepublishing.com.
 Warm regards,
 [sender]
 Organising Committee
 First International Conference on AI Challenges in Business and Management 
 ICAICBM 2027 
 GLARE Global Centre for Research and Publishing Ltd

View in browser

Dear [recipient] [recipient],
We're conducting a short follow-up study to a project completed earlier this year exploring research processes, including how researchers find relevant content and choose where to submit their work. As research practices continually evolve in light of technological developments, understanding these behaviours will help us track changing needs and identify emerging trends in how researchers discover, evaluate, and engage with scholarly content.
